text:
tara: Quick note  I'm going to cleanup the Hello Web quickstart Docker flow. Found three things: hardcoded API key in sample, Dockerfile starts app as root, and the local-dev CORS example is missing Access-Control-Allow-Credentials. I'll open a small PR with fixes and a GH Actions secrets example.
leo: Awesome. Can you add a tiny section showing how to set secrets in GitHub Actions (env + repo secret)? People copy the API key into workflows.
tara: Yes. Planning to replace `const API_KEY = 'sk_...'` with DefaultCredentials usage and an example GH action like:
```yaml
name: CI
on: [push]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set REDWOOD_API_KEY
        run: echo "REDWOOD_API_KEY=${{ secrets.REDWOOD_API_KEY }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
      - name: Run samples
```
irene: For Dockerfile, please change the ENTRYPOINT to a non-root user and add a healthcheck. Also mention `npm ci` instead of `npm install` for reproducible builds.
tara: Will do. Current Dockerfile had `USER root` and `CMD ["node","server.js"]`. I'll switch to building as root, then `RUN useradd -m appuser && chown -R appuser /app` and `USER appuser` before CMD. Add healthcheck: `HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s CMD curl -f http://localhost:3000/health || exit 1`.
sam: Can you also add a short troubleshooting subsection about CORS and cookies for local-dev? Many folks miss the credential flag. Something like:
- Ensure Access-Control-Allow-Origin matches origin
- Use Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true when sending cookies
- In fetch, set credentials: 'include'
That should save a bunch of issues.
tara: Yep adding that. Also planning a single-line migration hint for folks moving from SDK v4 to v6: update dependency, replace Client(options) with new RedwoodClient({ auth }), and check token method name change. Link to changelog.
leo: Small UX ask: in the sample's README, replace the inline run example that prints the token with a secure note: `Never log tokens` and show how to read from env or mounted secret.
tara: Added a :no_entry_sign: red warning and replaced the snippet with:
```js
// secure: don't print tokens in logs
const creds = await DefaultCredentials.load();
const client = new RedwoodClient({ auth: creds });
```
ci-bot: PR draft created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/518-web-quickstart-docker-ci-auth-fix  checks queued: markdown-lint, link-check, sample-runner.
sam: I'll run the site preview and give a quick copyedit. If markdown renders the GH Actions snippet weird, tweak code fence language to `yaml`.
leo: After merge can you add a one-line item in CHANGELOG for the patch release: "web quickstart: Dockerfile non-root, GH Actions secrets example, auth snippet cleanup, CORS troubleshooting"
tara: Yep. Aiming to land before afternoon docs patch. Thanks all! :tada:
